summary: Mr. Arking presents the background and various rabbinic opinions regarding when to recite the prayer Berich Shmeh upon opening the Hekhal to remove the Sefer Torah. He examines sources including the Zohar, Sha'ar HaKavanot, and rulings by the Ramaz, Kaf Hahaim, and Ben Ish Hai. He then contrasts these views with the established Minhag of Halab as documented in historical Syrian siddurim.
